script: I watched my life crumble—then a secret plan exposed Iran's hidden escape.. I am living in Iran, the absolute worst country on Earth. Everything that keeps us sane—YouTube, Telegram, WhatsApp, even the internet—is banned. Inflation on food and basics is at 200%, prices jump three times a week. When I flip on the news, I see clips of the UK, Canada, Japan, and I am hit with this brutal contrast: they're living it up, traveling, having fun, and we're stuck behind a wall, no concerts, no gatherings, no free speech. The government even kills people on the streets. I stare at my phone and think, "What did I do to deserve this nightmare?" (Apologies if this sounded like a rant.)
